text:
ashwin: Kicking off observability provisioning for the new gpu-cluster-eu2 (region bring-up). Focus: logs/metrics/traces + dashboards + alert templates. I pushed the initial terraform/helm PR. Can folks validate the checklist below and volunteer to own dashboard/alert handoff?

marie: ack. I can take dashboards and alert tuning for the model-serving namespace. list the default alert thresholds you want. :+1:

ashwin: thanks. Current plan (high-level):
- metrics: Prometheus + node-exporter + nvidia-smi exporter + kube-state-metrics + custom exporter for inference queue length
- logs: promtail -> Loki, with labels: cluster, region, namespace, instance_type
- traces: Tempo (frontend sampling) + app instrumentations (otlp)
- dashboard provisioning via grafana provisioning API (repo: infra/grafana/provisioning/eu2)
- alerting: prometheusAlertmanager + default templates in infra/alerts/gpu

ashwin: Checklist for validation (quick steps):
1) Helm releases exist: `helm ls -n observability` should show prometheus, loki, tempo, grafana, promtail
2) Prometheus scrapes: `kubectl -n observability get servicemonitor` and check `node-exporter`, `nvidia-smi` targets up
3) Loki ingestion: `kubectl logs -n observability deployment/loki` for `level=info` and no `rejecting` errors
4) Grafana provisioning: login -> confirm dashboards from provisioning folder present
5) Alerts firing: check `alertmanager` UI and `promtool check rules` on prometheus rules
6) Traces: send a test span from the inference sidecar with `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` pointing to tempo and confirm visible trace in grafana/tempo UI

todd: adding a few prod constraints we agreed on: retention & sampling. default suggestions: logs retention prod=30d, non-prod=7d; traces sampling prod=1%, non-prod=5%; metrics retention 90d for prometheus remote write (thanos or remote-storage). note cost implications.

sam: on the exporters: the `nvidia-smi` exporter we use is `nvidia-dcgm-exporter` right? make sure driver version supported (installed via node daemonset). I saw a node with dcgm crash on last eu2 node image.

ashwin: yes dcgm. I've included a post-deploy init job that runs `dcgmi pmon` smoke test. the init job lives in infra/ops/smoke/eu2-dcgm-check.yaml. run: 
```
kubectl -n observability run dcgm-check --restart=Never --image=nvcr.io/nvidia/driver-tools:latest -- dcgmi pmon
```
should return metrics.

olga: for dashboards, I will provision two templates: `GPU cluster overview` and `Inference service SLOs`. The overview has: GPU mem util, GPU temp, GPU power, node allocatable GPUs, pod gpu_requests, pod gpu_utilization. I'll add panels for hot nodes by temp and by memory.

marie: alert rules I want to start with (putting quick examples):
- GPU_Memory_High: fires if `gpu_memory_used_bytes / gpu_memory_total_bytes > 0.9` for 2m
- GPU_Node_Down: `up{job=\"node-exporter\", instance=~\".*eu2.*\"} == 0` for 3m
- Inference_Queue_Growth: `rate(inference_queue_length[1m]) > 50` for 5m -> snd to pager
- Pod_CrashLooping: `increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=\"model-serving\"}[5m]) > 3`

marie: sample prometheus rule (put into infra/alerts/gpu/eu2-gpu.rules.yml):
```
alert: GPU_Memory_High
expr: (sum by (instance) (nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes) / sum by (instance) (nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes)) > 0.9
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: critical
annotations:
  summary: \"GPU memory >90% on {{ $labels.instance }}\"
  description: \"Investigate pods on node; consider draining or scaling cluster\"
```

sam: logging/labels note: please ensure `tenant` label is present for multi-tenant customers otherwise Loki queries get expensive. also set `loki_ingester_chunk_target_size` to the recommended value for large clusters.

ashwin: good call. I've added tenant label to promtail config: `pipeline_stages: - docker: {}` and `labels: {tenant: \"${TENANT:-unknown}\"}` in infra/manifests/promtail-eu2.yaml

infra-bot: Deploy triggered: terraform apply started by ashwin on branch `obs/eu2` — plan 12 to add, 3 to change. (this is an automated message)

deploy-bot: Helm release `prometheus-eu2` succeeded in namespace `observability` (commit a1b2c3)

todd: validation gotcha: Prometheus remote_write to our long-term storage (thanos) must be throttled for initial backfill. set `write_relabel_configs` to drop high-card metrics (don't include pod-level labels) for the first 24h. otherwise cost spike.

olga: for dashboard handoff, after I provision panels I'll create a PR to infra/grafana/provisioning/eu2 and tag `@marie` and `@todd` for review. I will also add a README with the query rationale and suggested panel thresholds.

ashwin: handoff checklist before SRE sign-off:
- [ ] All helm releases HEALTHY
- [ ] Prometheus targets UP > 95%
- [ ] Loki ingesters not OOMing
- [ ] 2 sample traces visible end-to-end
- [ ] Dashboard PR merged and provisioning shows panels in grafana
- [ ] Alerts loaded with silence windows for initial noisy alerts
- [ ] Runbook link added to infra runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/observability-eu2

marie: I'll start with alert tuning and silences during the first 6h after traffic. paging thresholds might be too sensitive at the beginning.

sam: I'll run the dcgm smoke job and verify node exporter metrics, then post results here.

ashwin: perfect. can we aim for handoff by EOD UTC? if anyone can't, call it out.

todd: I can help during the final checks after 18:00 UTC. cost note: enable metrics ingestion sampling for pod-level metrics to 10% for non-critical namespaces to keep cardinality down.

sam: dcgm smoke passed on 3/3 nodes. node metrics present: `nvidia_gpu_utilization` & `nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes` visible in prometheus.

marie: alerted on a test alert (GPU_Memory_High) to verify routing — alertmanager routed to #oncall and created incident with severity=P0 test. routing ok.

ashwin: thanks everyone. leaving the checklist here. I'll mark `infra/sre-ticket#2345` for the formal handoff and attach the dashboard PR. once ticket is closed we can flip retention to prod values. :rocket:
